$comment: Gzip size budgets for the Pages build (production editor and player), checked by `node scripts/bundle-report.mjs --budgets scripts/bundle-budgets.json apps/player/dist apps/editor/dist` in preview.yml. Each limit is the measured size plus about 10%. When a change grows a bundle on purpose, build as preview.yml does (`pnpm build:pages`), rerun the report with --json, and set the limit to the new size plus about 10% in the same change.
